answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering network influence to verifiable capital rather than ephemeral digital personas. Like a dense nebula of assets, staked value ensures that creating a false island of identities provides no additional weight without proportional financial outlay. The systemic cost to an attacker is the equivalent of acquiring a pile of timber—a scarce, tangible resource—thereby making fraudulent proliferation economically non-viable and computationally futile.
